I implemented the `sharesHousehold` / `householdId` feature in the Spring PetClinic REST app.

**Behavior:** On `POST /api/owners`, when the request sets `sharesHousehold: true`, an owner is allowed even if an existing owner already shares the same household (same last name + postal address, compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace) — the pre-existing 409 conflict is bypassed.
